chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Beware of associating with the lowly, for it does not lead to any good.

key_terms.إِيَّاكُمْ: a warning meaning: beware of or guard yourselves against
key_terms.السَّفِلَةِ: the lowly, vile, or base people
key_terms.مُخَالَطَةَ: close association, mingling, or social companionship

ai.seo_question: Why did the Imam عليه السلام warn against associating with lowly people?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام warns against keeping company with vile and base people. Such association is described as having no good outcome, highlighting the moral and social impact of one's companions.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3605 - Imam (as) said: "Beware of associating with the lowly, for it does not lead to any good."
